💡 This review reframes binder roles through the "active-material microenvironment" (AMME) concept—the local charge-transport environment around each particle—rather than mere component binding. It links Si-anode volume-change challenges to binder regulation of AMME formation, activation, and aging across the electrode life cycle, and outlines AMME-guided binder design for dry-processed, all-solid-state, and high-capacity electrodes using operando characterization and AI-driven approaches.
